en.title: Left Something at a Jeju Hotel After Check-out? How to Get It Back
en.desc: Forgot something in your Jeju hotel room? How to contact the hotel, what details to give, and how to get the item sent to you after you've left Korea.
en.h1: Left Something at a Jeju Hotel
summary: Contact the hotel front desk directly — by phone, email, or the booking app's message function. Give your name, room number and dates.
Hotels keep forgotten items for a limited period set by each hotel, so get in touch quickly.
Most hotels won't ship abroad themselves, or charge express rates. Jeju Live can collect it from the hotel and send it to you.

sections.body:
• Name on the booking (in English, as on your passport)
  • Room number and check-in / check-out dates
  • Booking number and the site you booked on (Trip.com, Agoda, Booking.com, etc.)
  • Where you left it — safe, wardrobe, bathroom, under the bed — and what it looks like

Housekeeping logs items found during cleaning, so the room number and check-out date are usually enough to find it.

• Message through your booking platform — the platform can contact the hotel for you.
  • Call 1330, the free 24-hour travel helpline, which can interpret a call to the hotel in English, Chinese or Japanese.
  • If you suspect theft rather than loss, report it to the police.

sections.h: Getting it back after you've left
sections.body:
Options, in order of cost:

  1. Collect it on a future trip — ask the hotel how long they'll keep it.
  2. Jeju Live proxy pickup — we collect it from the hotel with your authorization and ship it to you. The hotel will usually ask for the booking name and room number, and sometimes a copy of your passport.
  3. Hotel ships it — some hotels will, usually by express courier at your cost.

faq.q: How long do Jeju hotels keep forgotten items?
faq.a: Each hotel sets its own period. Contact them within a few days to be safe.

faq.q: Why does the proxy pickup ask for my passport?
faq.a: Hotels and police stations need to confirm the item is released to the owner's authorized representative. The copy is used only for the pickup and deleted afterwards.

faq.q: I left something in the room safe.
faq.a: Tell the hotel immediately. Safes are checked at check-out cleaning, and the contents are usually kept by the front office.

zh.title: 济州酒店退房后落了东西？怎么拿回来
zh.desc: 在济州酒店房间里落了东西？如何联系酒店、需要提供哪些信息，以及回国后怎么把东西寄回来。
summary: 直接联系酒店前台——电话、邮件或预订 App 的消息功能都可以。提供姓名、房号和入住日期。
各酒店保管遗留物品的期限不同，请尽快联系。
大多数酒店不提供国际寄送，或按国际快递收费。Jeju Live 可以替你去酒店取回再寄给你。

sections.body:
• 预订人姓名（与护照一致的拼音）
  • 房号和入住、退房日期
  • 订单号和预订平台（携程、Agoda、Booking.com 等）
  • 落在哪里——保险箱、衣柜、卫生间、床底——以及物品特征

客房清洁时发现的物品会登记，所以一般有房号和退房日期就能找到。

• 通过预订平台发消息，平台客服可以代你联系酒店。
  • 拨打 1330 免费24小时旅游热线，可以提供中文翻译帮你给酒店打电话。
  • 如果怀疑是被偷而不是遗失，请报警。

按费用从低到高：

  1. 下次来济州时领取——问清酒店能保管多久。
  2. Jeju Live 代领——凭你的委托去酒店取回并寄给你。酒店通常需要预订人姓名和房号，有时还需要护照复印件。可通过微信沟通。
  3. 酒店代寄——部分酒店可以，一般走国际快递，费用自理。

faq.q: 济州酒店会保管遗留物品多久？
faq.a: 各酒店规定不同，建议几天内联系。

faq.q: 代领为什么需要护照照片？
faq.a: 酒店和派出所需要确认物品交给的是失主委托的人。照片只用于领取，完成后删除。

faq.q: 东西落在房间保险箱里了。
faq.a: 马上告诉酒店。退房清洁时会检查保险箱，里面的物品通常由前台保管。
